caption: Figure d1: the first e-detector crossing $n_M$ of $1/\alpha$ against Definition 2.1's alarm round $\tau$ over the full unfiltered pool (C52) -- one point per run of the pool, dashed $y=x$, marginal histogram of $\tau - n_M$.

config.eq5_relation: Eq. (5) of Thm 2.2's proof is the subset relation {tau<=n} subset {M_n>=1/alpha}; a fully coinciding pool is legal and is reported, never forced
config.selection: none -- every one of the 120 pool runs is a fig-d1.csv row; selected_for_plot marks only the both-fired runs the scatter can place

how_to_read:
Each point is one run of the full pool; the x-axis is the Definition
2.1 alarm round `τ`, the y-axis is the round `n_M` at which the e-detector first crosses `1/α`.
Every point must sit on or below the dashed `y=x` line; the histogram along the margin shows how
many rounds early the e-detector typically fires.
